newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA CALL UP DALE AND GILCHRIST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA CALL UP DALE AND GILCHRIST.

text.p: Australia have called up wicketkeeper Adam Gilchrist and fast bowler Adam Dale to their squad for the forthcoming one-day series against South Africa.
Queensland's Dale comes in for fellow paceman Glenn McGrath, who is returning home to rest a foot injury.

Gilchrist has been drafted in as cover for wicketkeeper Ian Healy, who misses the first two games of the seven-match series after being banned for showing dissent following his dismissal in the third and final test in Pretoria on Monday.
The limited overs internationals begin in East London on Saturday.

Australia's revised squad: Mark Taylor (captain), Stuart Law, Michael DiVenuto, Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Greg Blewett, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Jason Gillespie, Paul Reiffel, Andrew Bichel, Brendon Julian, Adam Gilchrist, Adam Dale.
